Annual value $250,000.00, a 9% uplift on the current term, held at this price if signed by 2026-10-17.

Terms

3. The MSA and DPA signed by Celestine Health are incorporated by reference into ORD-403235.
4. Support for Celestine Health is the enterprise tier, to the response targets in Schedule B.
